quandoUsar: A few parts of a whole (up to about six), when each slice's share matters more than the exact comparison between values.
Switching between datasets with the same keys (month by month, plan by plan): the arcs transform instead of redrawing.
When the user needs to hide categories in the legend to see how the rest of the ring redistributes.
quandoEvitar: Use `composition-chart` when the space is a horizontal strip: the same parts fit in a stacked bar with a legend.
Use `treemap` when there are many parts or hierarchy levels; here, whatever falls below `groupBelow` or beyond `maxSegments` is grouped into “Other”.
Use `gauge` for a single value against a known range; the donut splits a total into parts.

teclado.acao: Move focus between the legend rows, wrapping at the ends; the focused row highlights the arc and appears in the center.
Go to the first and last legend rows.
In the legend, hide or show the segment (`legendAction="toggle"`) or pin it as selected (`legendAction="select"`).

acessibilidade: The SVG is decorative (`aria-hidden`): the screen reader gets a summary with the total and slices, a hidden table with segment, value, and share, and `aria-live` announcements when a segment is shown or hidden.

Each legend row is a button with `aria-pressed` and an `aria-label` with name, value, and percentage; with `legend={false}`, the ring becomes a focusable group where the arrow keys read each segment and `Enter` or `Space` pins it.
`label` is required and names the figure; the texts generated for screen readers (“hidden”, “Segment”, “Includes…”) are hardcoded in English.
movimento: The first time 35% of the chart enters the viewport, the arcs open from the top in a single sweep, with each arc's trailing edge a moment behind the previous one.

When `data` changes or a segment is hidden, each arc moves from where it is to the new angle on a spring with no overshoot; equal keys keep position and color, and the segment that leaves closes until it disappears.
The active segment slides outward and thickens while the others fade, and the center changes its readout by rolling like a drum; with “reduced motion”, all of this changes instantly.
responsivo: The figure is a container (`container-type: inline-size`): at 460 px or more the legend sits beside the ring; below that, it goes underneath.
The ring is `size` px in diameter (208 by default) and shrinks to fit narrower containers; long labels in the center are truncated with an ellipsis.
desempenho: During animations, shapes are written straight to the DOM, one paint per frame, and numbers straight to the text: no frame re-renders React.
notasIA: `label` is required, and each item in `data` needs a stable `key`, `label`, and `value`; zero or negative values are discarded.

Selection (`activeKey`, `onActiveChange`) and hidden segments (`hiddenKeys`, `onHiddenKeysChange`) can be controlled or uncontrolled; the cursor only previews, clicking an arc pins or releases the selection, and the last visible segment is never hidden.
Colors follow `--series-1` through `--series-4` and then neutral tones (pass `color` on the item to go beyond); a parent with a width is enough, since the height comes from the content.
